entities.summary: Elmadağ is a municipality and district of Ankara Province, Turkey. Its area is 647 km2, and its population is 44,379 (2022). Its average elevation is 1,135 m (3,724 ft), with the highest point being Mt. İdris at 1,995 m (6,545 ft).
